definition: Characteristic of autumn, especially its maturity, decline, or atmosphere.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: For many years, the—a—I would say the flower of the bar, and the—a—I would presume to add, the matured autumnal fruits of the woolsack—have been lavished upon Jarndyce and Jarndyce.
example_sentence: The park looked gloriously autumnal this morning.
